北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感-8℃，北风呼呼吹，多穿点哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like -8℃ with a north wind. Bundle up!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾弥漫，能见度低，出门请注意交通安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, visibility low. Drive safe and take care!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，空气湿润。出行注意安全，别着凉了！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and humid. Be safe when out, don't catch a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，体感温暖。阳光正好，出门散散步吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm. Perfect weather for a stroll!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，气温 18℃，湿度适中，尽享好天气！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, 18℃. Enjoy the beautiful day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 9℃，记得添衣保暖，注意交通安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, feels like 9℃. Dress warmly and watch for traffic.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 5℃。有点冷，多穿衣别感冒哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and chilly, feels like 5℃. Dress warm, don't get sick!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 11℃。天气微凉，记得带件外套哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 11℃. It's cool, bring a jacket.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感-2℃，又湿又冷！务必穿暖和，小心慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy, feels like -2℃, cold and damp! Dress warm and drive carefully.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温 3℃，体感 0℃。出门别忘添衣，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cool, feels like 0℃. Don't forget to layer up!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，外出请戴口罩。体感 12℃，注意适时添减衣物。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, wear a mask if going out. Feels like 12℃, adjust clothing as needed.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴，但体感-29℃，非常冷！请务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -29℃, extremely cold! Bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感-23℃。请做好最严密的防寒措施！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels like -23℃. Take extreme precautions against the cold!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 9℃。早晚温差大，记得带件薄外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 9℃. Large temperature difference, bring a light jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，湿度 80%。出行注意安全，路面湿滑哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and humid. Be safe when out, roads might be slippery.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，北风 4级，体感-10℃！防风保暖别大意！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and chilly, feels like -10℃ with strong winds! Stay warm and wind-proof!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感-16℃，风力不小。注意防寒保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -16℃ with a brisk wind. Stay warm!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃
